scenarios.title: Harmonize reduces the cost by the power of the creature tapped

setup.notes: Unending Whisper (U, sorcery: draw a card) has Harmonize {5}{U}. All of A's Islands and Grizzly Bears are untapped.

decisions: A casts Unending Whisper from the graveyard using harmonize, tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2) and paying the reduced total cost with four Islands.
Both players pass; Unending Whisper resolves.

variants.label: tap_bears
variants.expected: The cast is legal with a total cost of {3}{U}. Grizzly Bears becomes tapped and the four Islands are tapped. A draws Island.

variants.label: tap_nothing
variants.delta: A taps no creature when paying the harmonize cost.
variants.expected: The cast is not legal: the total cost stays {5}{U} and A has only four Islands. Unending Whisper stays in A's graveyard.

variants.label: bigger_creature
variants.delta: A controls Hill Giant (power 3) instead of Grizzly Bears and taps it.
variants.expected: The cast is legal with a total cost of {2}{U}. Hill Giant becomes tapped and three Islands are tapped, leaving one Island untapped. A draws Island.

scenarios.title: A spell cast with harmonize is exiled as it resolves

setup.notes: Unending Whisper (U, sorcery: draw a card) has Harmonize {5}{U}. Two copies: one in A's hand, one in A's graveyard.

decisions: A casts the graveyard copy of Unending Whisper using harmonize, tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2) and four Islands.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: harmonize_cast
variants.expected: The spell resolves and A draws Island. The cast copy moves from the stack to exile, not to the graveyard. The hand copy stays in A's hand.

variants.label: cast_from_hand
variants.delta: A instead casts the hand copy for its mana cost {U}, tapping one Island, without harmonize.
variants.expected: The spell resolves and A draws Island. It moves from the stack to A's graveyard, which now holds two Unending Whisper. The graveyard copy is unchanged.

scenarios.title: A countered harmonize spell is exiled instead of going to the graveyard

setup.notes: Unending Whisper (U, sorcery: draw a card) has Harmonize {5}{U}. Two copies: one in A's hand, one in A's graveyard. B's two Islands are untapped.

decisions: A casts the graveyard copy of Unending Whisper using harmonize, tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2) and four Islands.
B casts Counterspell targeting it, tapping both Islands.

variants.label: harmonize_countered
variants.expected: The spell is countered and A draws nothing. It moves from the stack to exile, not to A's graveyard. B's Counterspell moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: hand_countered
variants.delta: A casts the hand copy for {U} (tapping one Island, no creature tapped) instead of the graveyard copy, and B counters it.
variants.expected: The spell is countered and A draws nothing. It moves from the stack to A's graveyard, which now holds two Unending Whisper. B's Counterspell moves to B's graveyard.
